## Sable Offshore Corp. Announces Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release Date and Conference Call


10/26/2026


Download (opens in new window)


HOUSTON--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Sable Offshore Corp. (the “ *Company* ”) (NYSE: SOC) today announced that it plans to release its third quarter 2026 financial and operating results before the market opens on Monday, November 9, 2026. The Company will host a conference call and webcast to discuss the results on the same day at 11:00 a.m. Eastern Time (10:00 a.m. Central Time).


**Conference Call Information**


Interested parties may register for and access the live webcast at[https://sable-offshore-corp-3q-2026-earnings-call-nov-2026.open-exchange.net/](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fsable-offshore-corp-3q-2026-earnings-call-nov-2026.open-exchange.net%2F&esheet=54627347&newsitemid=20261026221567&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fsable-offshore-corp-3q-2026-earnings-call-nov-2026.open-exchange.net%2F&index=1&md5=bfdbb4989883b3ba07a8965ffc53b1d8) or through the Company website at[sableoffshore.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.sableoffshore.com&esheet=54627347&newsitemid=20261026221567&lan=en-US&anchor=sableoffshore.com&index=2&md5=b0a3945e261e8f812bdee4cf756fd644) . A replay of the webcast will be available on Sable's website following the call.


Harrison Breaud
Vice President, Finance & Investor Relations
